scripts.test:smoke: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && node scripts/smoke-pages.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:visual: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/visual
scripts.test:visual:update: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/visual --update-snapshots
scripts.test:a11y: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/a11y
scripts.test:policy-style: grep -q '^test-results/$' .gitignore && grep -q '^playwright-report/$' .gitignore && grep -q '^\.playwright-cache/$' .gitignore && grep -q '^\.playwright-tmp/$' .gitignore || (echo 'Error: Required Playwright artifact paths missing from .gitignore' && exit 1)
scripts.screenshots:site: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/screenshots
